evidenceContract.userBehavior: In a creative Workspace, explicitly request one complete PV production specification and one submit-ready AI video handoff without executing generation.
canonicalPath: OpenNeko product prompt explicit production-and-handoff classification
one master production specification plus one creator-facing submit-ready video handoff

observables.description: Exact Skill receipts, screenplay and illustration evidence, one master production specification, a schema-bound semantic video handoff, and absent generation side effects.

evidenceContract.expectedResult: The Agent returns one concise master PV production specification containing a source-to-decision map, plot/character/scene/style/sound baseline, exact preparation assets, one authoritative shot table with bound inputs, production method and direct acceptance conditions, one source-bound submit-ready/not-executed semantic video handoff, and one finishing/work/delivery contract. The handoff remains executable without printing Tool schema or invocation JSON. It does not create per-stage documents or execute generation.
evidenceContract.expectedFailure: Creating a task plan for the bounded design turn, stopping at concept beats, omitting preparation assets, character/scene continuity or post-production design, expanding into a reading log, splitting stages into separate documents, requiring the user to name Skills, appending a provisional prompt, omitting real input binding, inventing Tool parameters, printing runtime invocation details, or generating media fails.

steps.prompt: 读取 @screenplay.fountain 和 @station-illustration.svg。为这个故事编写一份完整的 60 秒动画概念 PV 主制作规格，包含人物与场景连续性、权威镜头表以及后期与交付合同；再把其中一个关键镜头准备成可交给当前 AI 视频能力直接提交但不执行的生产交接。
